opportunity: Round E's O2 census: the largest O2-noinline blocker bucket is a program struct pointer declared void * in an otherwise-right function (143 functions O2-noinline, 20 O2; 66 gnulib Hash_table getters). Two causes: structsynth wants two offsets including 0 and never runs in a function whose lattice settles on its first pass, and nothing flows caller -> callee (protoorder is callee -> caller).
